definitions.explanation: A man with attractive features. As a noun, refers to a handsome man; as a na-adjective, describes someone as handsome.
Used more broadly (including for women) to describe someone whose behavior is impressively decisive, bold, or admirable. A relatively recent colloquial extension.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{男前|おとこまえ}だ。
⟦お{父|とう}さん→お父さん：02855_otousan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}、{男前|おとこまえ}だったらしい。
examples.english: Apparently, Dad was handsome when he was young.

examples.japanese: {男前|おとこまえ}な⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧CM⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: Apparently, when a handsome actor appears in a commercial, sales of that product increase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦さっぱりした→さっぱりする：26802_sapparisuru⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男前|おとこまえ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。

examples.japanese: 「⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おごる→おごる：08157_ogoru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧「{男前|おとこまえ}！」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{叫|さけ}んだ→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧。
examples.english: When she said 'This one's on me,' everyone yelled 'What a boss!'

examples.japanese: ⟦{迷|まよ}わ→迷う：02426_mayou⟧ず⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{男前|おとこまえ}だな⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I thought it was really cool how she could make decisions without hesitation.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the traditional meaning, referring to a man's attractive appearance. Originally from the Kansai dialect but now used nationwide. Sense 2 is a newer colloquial usage where {男前|おとこまえ} describes someone (regardless of gender) who acts in an admirably bold or decisive way.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男前|おとこまえ}な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (handsome face)
- ⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{男前|おとこまえ} (quite handsome)
- {男前|おとこまえ}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (cool/bold personality — sense 2)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦イケメン→イケメン：04761_ikemen⟧: good-looking guy (casual, modern slang)
- ⟦ハンサム→ハンサム：00090_hansamu⟧: handsome (loanword, slightly dated)
- ⟦{格好|かっこう}いい→格好いい：18585_kakkouii⟧: cool, good-looking (broader, can describe things and people)
